name: vwap_mean_reversion_basic_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, moderate intraday deviations of 0.10-0.20% below (or above) session VWAP — roughly 24-48 spot points at 24000 — that coincide with a 5-second bar volume surge (exceeding 1.5x the 20-minute average) mark the climax of retail stop-sweep and short-duration algo momentum flow, not institutional directional conviction. VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks who have been patiently waiting at this deviation level then begin aggressive accumulation, since every fill at -0.12% from VWAP gives them meaningful benchmark outperformance. RSI(24) reading between 25-40 (a 2-minute exhaustion window) confirms momentum is fading but not yet spent — the institutional absorption has begun but the spot price hasn't fully turned. Two consecutive rising 5-second bars provide microstructure confirmation that the retail sell wave has been absorbed.
core_signal_oneliner: 0.12% VWAP deviation with volume surge (1.5x), RSI 25-40, and two consecutive reversal 5s bars confirming climax absorption
